title: Math Function
text: Perform mathematical function, 2 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Function} sets Math function; {Algorithm method}, {Signed power} sets the power signedness, {Output signal type} sets the complexity of output signal, {Number of iterations} sets the number of Newton-Raphson iterations, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Output data type} sets the output data type, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations and {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the behavior when integer overflow occurs. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Result of the operation of the function on the input or inputs scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Function
params.values: Math function exp (default) | log | 2^u | 10^u | log10 | magnitude^2 | square | pow | conj | reciprocal | hypot | rem | mod | transpose | hermitian

params.name: Algorithm method
params.values: Algorithm method for reciprocal function Exact (default) | Newton-Raphson

params.name: Output signal type
params.values: Complexity of output signal auto (default) | real | complex

params.name: Output minimum
params.values: Minimum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output maximum
params.values: Maximum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Specify the output data type Inherit: Same as first input (default) | Inherit: Inherit via internal rule | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | double | single | half | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0) | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) |

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Choose the behavior when integer overflow occurs on (default) | boolean
